**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause.** Deploy `dep-4471` to the gateway, by a.novak, changed `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Config landed at 02:13:41 UTC. Connections stopped freeing up right after.

**Impact window.** Started 02:14:19 UTC. Still active as of the last log line, 03:59:27 UTC. Not yet resolved.

**What broke.** Connection pool maxed out at 20, all in use. The wait queue kept growing, from 13 waiting at the first error to 74 by the end of the log. Every `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/orders`, and `/v1/catalog/search` request was failing with 503 `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`. `/health` kept returning 200 the whole time, so the process itself was fine, just starved for connections.

**Blast radius.** Gateway only. Checked `worker.log` for the same window, all jobs ran clean.

**Action.** Roll back `dep-4471`, generation 119, on the gateway. That reverts `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.
